original.target_description: Study 2, incoming university freshmen: Reassurance Seeking scale versus ACT scores, partial correlation controlling test anxiety, high-school ranking percentile, high-school GPA, first-semester college GPA, and depression. Locator p. 6 corresponds to journal p. 276. Several partial correlations occur there; exact intended covariate set is unspecified, so target_match remains unknown.

n.sample_role: Participants contributing complete observations to the selected partial correlation; exact analytic count not printed.
n.exclusions: Variable-level missingness is evident; exact exclusions for the partial correlation cannot be established. Total sample 151 is not used as analytic n.

p.location: PDF p. 6 / journal p. 276, Criterion Validity, same fully adjusted correlation

replication.target_description: Reassurance seeking predicting ACT scores controlling for high school rank percentile and GPA; primary replication test, one-tailed p.

n.exclusions: Missing observed values (table Ns 53–59) were mean-imputed.
n.quote:
Fifty-nine Introduction to Psychology students from a large university in the midwestern United
States were recruited to participate in this study. ... The amount of missing data was small, so mean
imputation was used to account for missing data.

es.quote:

notes:
Original title verified against DOI and author-provided full-text HTML. Selected fullest adjusted partial correlation; p. 276 also reports reassurance-seeking partial r = −.32 controlling test anxiety and −.33 controlling superstitious behavior. Neutral description and page do not uniquely specify the intended adjustment. Original analytic n unestablished; Table 2 variable counts and pairwise range are not the n for the selected partial correlation. Replication title verified, but available institutional and publisher records contain only an abstract, which was not accepted as full text. No statistics or verdict extracted from abstracts. Acquisition routes: DOI landing pages inaccessible in web tool; Unpaywall no OA locations; OpenAlex no best OA location; Europe PMC replication not in PMC and no PDF; publisher full text inaccessible and PDF 403; author lab publications has no paper download; research search found no open replication full text. Search results incidentally included prohibited-domain snippets; none was opened or used.
Source follow-up: Published online 2020 copy. The primary adjusted ACT test matches the replication hypothesis. The zero-order r=.00 is a different test; extra adjustment for test/cognitive anxiety on p.6 yields partial r=−.14, p=.165. Authors qualify support under that stronger adjustment.
